arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-deploy-workflow.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch fix/telegram-leads-central-workflow-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$work/vps"
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work/leads"
test "$(git -C "$work/vps" rev-parse HEAD)" = "a321835fd2c1a71de7ab7fb87e82b203056e1d2f"
test "$(git -C "$work/leads" rev-parse HEAD)" = "06651386feaccbd528378aae4fc1469751afa57d"
git -C "$work/vps" --no-pager diff --check HEAD
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B - "$work/vps" "$work/leads" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,re,sys
vps,leads=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
file=vps/'.github/workflows/telegram-leads-vps-stage-20261019.yml'
data=file.read_text()
assert re.search(r'^  TARGET_SHA: 06651386feaccbd528378aae4fc1469751afa57d$',data,re.M)
assert re.search(r'^  EXPECTED_INSTALLED: 06651386feaccbd528378aae4fc1469751afa57d$',data,re.M)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('leads_installer',leads/'scripts/deploy_project_only.py')
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
files=set(mod.RUNTIME_FILES)
assert len(files)==12 and len(files)==len(mod.RUNTIME_FILES)
compile_line=next(x for x in data.splitlines() if '-m py_compile' in x)
tar_line=next(x for x in data.splitlines() if 'tar -C "$target" -czf' in x)
extract=lambda line: set(re.findall(r'scripts/[a-z0-9-]+\.(?:py|sh)',line))
compile_set=extract(compile_line)
archive_set=extract(tar_line)
assert archive_set==files,{'missing':files-archive_set,'extra':archive_set-files}
python_set={x for x in files if x.endswith('.py')}
assert compile_set==python_set,{'missing':python_set-compile_set,'extra':compile_set-python_set}
try:
 import yaml
 document=yaml.safe_load(data)
 assert isinstance(document,dict) and isinstance(document.get('jobs'),dict)
 print('YAML_PARSE_PASS',flush=True)
except ImportError:
 print('YAML_PARSER_ABSENT_STATIC_STRUCTURE_ONLY',flush=True)
print('CANONICAL_RUNTIME_FILES',len(files),flush=True)
print('ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_EXACT',archive_set==files,flush=True)
print('PY_COMPILE_MANIFEST_EXACT',compile_set==python_set,flush=True)
print('TARGET_INSTALLED_SHA_MATCH',True,flush=True)
print('READ_ONLY_WORKFLOW_CERTIFIED',flush=True)
PY
